title: Business and Supply Chain Manager at Jabil Inc. Sees AVC Volume Growing Amid Sustained Data Center Demand
expert: Business and Supply Chain Manager at Jabil (current); buys AVC GPU/ASIC thermal solutions since ~2024
verdict: The expert's AVC volume has grown 4–5% q/q over the past year, AVC holds 40–45% of his Rubin cold-plate volume and new-gen prices are up 5–12% since 2024, though supply assurance slipped to 75–80%.

Nvidia content and share: 🟢 40–45% of his Rubin cold-plate volume, none lost to Auras, Cooler Master or Delta, vs ~30% GB share (SB #64467). → Tenet 1 (Rubin content and share) ↑
Gross margin: 🟢 New-gen cold-plate and manifold prices +5–12% since 2024, mature -5% (first-hand), vs reference -40–50% in the 2026-11-06 Dell call: conflicting. → Tenet 3 (GM 34%+) ↑
Rubin yield and ramp: 🔴 Supply assurance 75–80% vs 80–87% a year ago; incoming rejects 1–2% (first-hand). → Tenet 4 (capacity) ↓
ASIC liquid-cooling start: ⚪ Next-gen ASIC share loss single digits as alternatives qualify (estimate), first read.

changes: AVC 40-45% of the expert's Rubin cold-plate volume vs ~30% Nvidia GB share (SB #64467) and JPM ~50% per project (SB #58861): holding.
New-gen prices +5-12% since 2024 vs JPM ASP raises (SB #58857): consistent; vs reference prices -40-50% in the 2026-11-06 Dell call: conflicting (product mix).
Supply assurance 75-80% vs 80-87% a year ago (expert's own): deteriorating.
Incoming rejects 1-2% vs leak incidents below 1% in the 2026-11-06 Dell call: slightly worse.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (Rubin content and share): ↑ — 40-45% of the expert's Rubin cold-plate volume; volume +4-5% q/q.
Tenet 3 (GM 34%+): ↑ — new-gen prices +5-12% since 2024; risk of 5-15% cuts after ramp.
Tenet 4 (capacity): ↓ — supply assurance down to 75-80% from 80-87%; rejects 1-2%.
